newsitem.title: UK: BZW DEALING PROFITS RISE IN H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: BZW DEALING PROFITS RISE IN H1 1997.

text.p: Dealing profits at BZW, Barclays Plc investment arm, rose to 228 million pounds ($365.1 million) in the first six-months from 169 million a year ago, figures released on Thursday showed.

"This reflects a strong performance in foreign exchange, due largely to the refocusing of the business, together with good results from the sterling fixed-income and money market businesses and favourable trading conditions in base metals in the early part of the year," Barclays said in a statement.
Dealing profits at Barclays were up to 234 million pounds in the first-half against 182 million pounds in the same 1996 period.
